record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: The three units in appliesTo declare BRAVE_BIRD: Staraptor (3 stars), Staravia (2 stars), Starly (1 star). The strategy is shared; unit differences are the star count, range and maxPP. Units not listed are not covered.
record.summary: The caster flies away to a cell chosen by Board.getFlyAwayCell (empty, outside its own range, in range of an enemy, fewest enemies able to hit it, farthest from the caster). If that succeeds and an empty cell is adjacent to the destination, the cast target is pulled (forced) to the first such cell and takes SPECIAL damage (raw 30/60/90/180 by stars). If no fly-away cell is found, or none of its neighbours is empty, nothing is damaged and the target is not moved; PP is spent either way.

targeting.who: the cast target, only after the caster has relocated and an empty adjacent cell exists
targeting.note: The fly-away cell's own `target` (the enemy it is in range of) is not used by this strategy; the damage goes to the original cast target, which may be a different unit. The destination is random among equally good cells, so which cell is used is not deterministic. The pulled target ends adjacent to the caster's new cell (the caster's old cell is empty after the swap but may also be adjacent to the new cell).

geometry.shape: caster relocation to a chosen far cell; target pulled to the first empty neighbour of that cell; single-target damage

effects.target: the cast target (after it was moved); not dealt when no fly-away cell or no empty adjacent cell exists
effects.scaling: requested = table[stars-1]. handleSpecialDamage: x (1 + AP/100) (apBoost default true); x critPower (reduced by Rocky Helmet / Black Augurite) only if the cast crit (canCritByDefault false, so needs ABILITY_CRIT); x2 once with DOUBLE_DAMAGE; x1.2 with STRANGE_STEAM_BOARD_EFFECT.
effects.resolution: applied = requested after those multipliers; PokemonState.handleDamage then applies attacker/field/weather multipliers, divides by (1 + ARMOR_FACTOR x speDef), rounds up with a minimum of 1 and lets the shield absorb first; takenDamage = shield damage + HP damage (HP part capped at current hp), 0 with protect / skydiving / magicBounce. The damage is applied even if moveTo refused to move the target (canBeMoved false): the strategy does not check moveTo's outcome.

effects.target: the caster, then the cast target

declaredRaw.description: caster: PokemonEntity.flyAway(board, false) to Board.getFlyAwayCell; target: forced moveTo the first empty cell adjacent to the caster's destination

effects.scaling: none from stars, AP or crit
effects.resolution: the caster's move is not forced (moveTo with forcedDisplacement false); the target's is forced and is skipped silently if the target (or the unit on the destination) cannot be moved. With flyAway(board, false) there is no skydive; the caster gains protect for 2000 ms only if it has FEATHER_DANCE, SKYDIVE or MAX_AIRSTREAM. All enemies targeting the caster lose their target.

starBehavior.note: Damage is indexed by the casting entity's stars; the 4-star value (180, also the ?? fallback) is not reachable by the bare factory star counts. Whether other mechanics raise an entity's star count was not examined.

record.positionalConditions: Needs a living enemy and an unoccupied destination cell for the fly-away; needs an empty cell next to that destination for the damage part. The destination is random among equally ranked cells.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state or modes. Each cast spends maxPP of PP and re-evaluates the board.
record.rawVsResolved: Requested: damage 30/60/90 (1/2/3 stars). Applied damage = requested x (1 + AP/100) x optional crit / double-damage / steam multipliers, then SPE_DEF division and minimum 1; takenDamage includes shield damage. The damage is conditional on the relocation succeeding.
